recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No current FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5786 unless Vocab reopens the broader question of new UI hinting mechanisms.
issue_request: FHIR-5786 asked whether ValueSet expansion UI hinting needed mechanisms other than hierarchical expansions, noting that the hierarchy was used for categorized picklists but the specification had not assigned semantics to it. The Published/Persuasive with Modification outcome was to mark the issue resolved by clearer definition, with comments saying a different task had added an explicit note that meaning could not be inferred from the hierarchy.
initial_application: No direct ValueSet source commit mentioning FHIR-5786 was found. The matching application was FHIR-8042, implemented by git commit 9bc3b77afaeb0acd3f6333788b85dd0a5a350463, which added the no-logical-relationship, no-inferencing, navigational-assistance wording to ValueSet notes and element comments.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The current ValueSet notes and StructureDefinition still contain the FHIR-8042 hierarchy clarification. FHIR-8042 and the separate FHIR-5788 $expand profile-parameter issue already have combined-branch audit commits, so they were not duplicated.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already satisfies FHIR-5786's accepted clarification, and adding more prose would be redundant.
